description: This file defines a template class JavaScriptFunctionType within the WPEFramework::JavaScript namespace, which serves as a wrapper for JavaScript handler functions, managing registration and callback handling for JavaScript functions in a browser-based JavaScript environment.

classes.name: JavaScriptFunctionType
classes.description: A template class that wraps JavaScript functions, managing registration and callback invocation, parameterized by the actual JavaScript function type.

methods.name: JavaScriptFunctionType
methods.description: Constructor that registers the JavaScript function type with its class definition.

methods.name: ~JavaScriptFunctionType
methods.description: Destructor that unregisters the JavaScript function type from its class definition.

methods.name: function
methods.description: Static callback method invoked by JavaScript engine, which delegates message handling to the Handler.
